_meta.note: Price-tab refresh. Rule applied: vendors with a first-party API get their official list price (Anthropic docs table, Google Gemini API pricing, OpenAI page from S273, DeepSeek peak rate, Z.ai table) or, where the vendor page is JS-only (Moonshot, MiniMax, Alibaba, Tencent, Upstage, Mistral), the vendor's own endpoint on OpenRouter; pure community-hosted open-weight models keep OpenRouter's listed price. xAI (docs.x.ai) and Mistral (mistral.ai/pricing/api) were checked and already matched. Biggest corrections: Claude Opus 5 / 4.8 / 4.7 are $5 / $25 (the stored $10/$50 and $30/$150 were the >200K long-context rate and a bogus snapshot); Gemini 3.7 Flash was stored at the Batch rate; Gemini 3.6 Flash was cut to $0.75 / $3.75; GLM-5.x and DeepSeek V4 now carry first-party rates instead of the cheapest third-party host.
